Definition and source: 2018 interview; age ≥60; community dwelling; at least two reported chronic conditions; qualifying functional difficulty.
Routing or interpretation: Exact frozen 2,433 members; no selection using follow-up.

Definition and source: At least one basic ADL difficulty or at least two IADL difficulties.
Routing or interpretation: Ten activity responses resolved in the original cohort.

Definition and source: Harmonized CHARLS r4agey and ragender; native codes 1 man, 2 woman. Age groups: 60–64, 65–69, 70–74, 75–79 and ≥80.
Routing or interpretation: Matched to the same frozen records. Age groups are exhaustive and nonoverlapping; counts and weighted percentages use each column’s full denominator (2,433 or 564). No missing values.

Definition and source: raeduc_c: 1–3 below completed primary (including traditional Sishu), 4 primary, 5–10 secondary or higher.
Routing or interpretation: No missing values in this cohort; schooling group is descriptive.

Definition and source: h4rural: urban community or rural village at the current interview.
Routing or interpretation: Current residence, not household registration (hukou); no missing values in either column.

Definition and source: r4mstath codes 1, 2 or 3: reported married or cohabiting; original BE001/BE002.
Routing or interpretation: Includes temporarily absent spouses; no implied partnership recoding. No missing values in either column.

Definition and source: h4hhres = 1; documented current coresident household roster.
Routing or interpretation: Not inferred from widowhood or absence of a spouse. No missing values in either column.

Definition and source: Original count of 14 reported conditions, retaining verified diagnostic routes.
Routing or interpretation: No new case definitions, imputation or selection.

Definition and source: Dressing, bathing, eating, bed transfer and toileting; db010–db014.
Routing or interpretation: Native 1 no difficulty; 2 difficulty but independent; 3 needs help; 4 unable.

Definition and source: Housework, meal preparation, shopping, finances and medication; db016–db020.
Routing or interpretation: Same four native categories; inability remains distinct.

Definition and source: B and I each sum response minus 1 across five activities, range 0–15.
Routing or interpretation: Ordinal need indices, not utility or formal disability grades.

Definition and source: Verified negative basic-ADL screening may establish no difficulty.
Routing or interpretation: Ordinary missing responses are not assigned zero difficulty.

Definition and source: Code 3 or 4 plus explicit no help for that same activity.
Routing or interpretation: A confirmed gap remains confirmed despite another unknown item.

Definition and source: Needed-help answers incomplete without any confirmed gap.
Routing or interpretation: Unknown is not no help; original function-first probability retained.

Definition and source: Confirmed family-helper report from the functional-module roster; denominator is all members of the column.
Routing or interpretation: May coexist with a gap; non-confirmation is not absence of help. Full roster unobserved/incomplete in 728 overall and 186 gap-subgroup records, including structural non-entry.

Definition and source: gap_known = 1 identifies exactly 564 of the original 2,433 participants. Original INDV_weight_ad2; descriptive SD and inverse weighted empirical quartiles.
Routing or interpretation: Each column uses its own weighted denominator. No p values, SMDs, complete-case selection or imputation. All displayed indicators have defined values; roster availability is distinguished above.

Definition and source: Same-person 2018–2020 link and current activity/help measurements.
Routing or interpretation: Death, unresolved qualification and measured non-entry remain separate.
